Marquis Frampton's betrayal gets exposed using evidence Leon and Hertrude gathered, and his attempt to pin it all on Dale collapses when Dale ends up dead instead. Was Leon right to skip the trial, or did he just become the thing he was fighting? Leave your take.

packages.show: Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2
packages.angle: High Command orders a manned-torpedo suicide-run against the Allied Kingdom's fleet -- and Tanya's unit treats it like just another Tuesday.
packages.hook_onscreen_text: The mission plan is: get in a torpedo. A person is inside it.
hook_candidates: The mission plan is: get in a torpedo.
Saga of Tanya the Evil just gave its army manned torpedoes -- and Tanya volunteered.
packages.hook_line: The mission plan is: get in a torpedo.
packages.opening_sentence: The mission plan is: get in a torpedo.
packages.vo: The mission plan is: get in a torpedo. A person is inside it. Episode 8, 'Lightning Strike,' has High Command send the 203rd Aerial Battalion on that exact mission after Ildoa refuses the Empire safe passage. Professor von Shugel personally presents the manned-torpedo devices, and Tanya's unit uses them to sink an Allied aircraft carrier along with other ships. Tanya treats the whole operation like a routine Tuesday. Afterward, the unit gets granted twenty-four hours of rest in Ildoa, seemingly just to rub the win in their reluctant ally's face. Is this genius military engineering, or the most Tanya war crime yet? Leave your take.
